description: This file defines the class 'ProjectJjwg_MapsLogicHook', which contains logic hooks for the 'jjwg_Maps' module within a SuiteCRM project. The hooks are triggered on events such as before save, after save, after relationship add, and after relationship delete, to update geocode information and manage related map data.

classes.name: ProjectJjwg_MapsLogicHook
classes.description: A class providing logic hook methods for map geocoding and relationship management in the SuiteCRM module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class by retrieving module info for 'jjwg_Maps'.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Handles pre-save event to update geocode info if hooks are enabled.

methods.name: updateRelatedMeetingsGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Handles post-save event to update related meetings' geocode info if hooks are enabled.

methods.name: addRelationship
methods.description: Handles post-relationship-add event; updates geocode info for related modules when a new relationship is added.

methods.name: deleteRelationship
methods.description: Handles post-relationship-delete event; updates geocode info for related modules when a relationship is deleted.
